notes: All historical successful retained video header probes are included exactly once. The separate owner scan adds filename-redacted nested per-sample measurements; no physical clip identity or cross-scan uniqueness is inferred.

Cohorts split observed channel, filename-classified mode, codec, dimensions, nominal playback FPS, and full-length versus short/partial duration. Settings are unknown; this is not evidence of one uniform configuration.
Full-length threshold: video-stream playback duration >=59.9 seconds. All other clips are short/partial. No short clip is attributed to TurboBoot or a particular startup behavior.

S-prefixed clips are kept in a separate parking-classified cohort. Filename classification does not establish configured parking mode, capture cadence, real elapsed coverage, or within-file transitions.

For this owner Z100 Master card cohort, the owner confirms the observed inside channel is physically the telephoto camera and reports a firmware labeling bug in the current firmware. The original inside label is retained as provenance; no exact firmware version or rear-camera evidence is established for that historical cohort. This mapping does not extend to other models or contributors.

The 19 original scanner numeric sample occurrences are retained separately without deduplication. They are not 19 additional videos, do not identify physical files, and can differ slightly from ffprobe values. App group codec summaries did not establish per-file codecs.

Historical cohort firmware remains null. An owner-tentative version was not independently confirmed and is not certified here. Separate owner DC009 power readings at 12.6 V with no cloud are published; no wake timing or startup timing is established.

Bounded header inspection is not full-file decode validation, footage review, or proof of capture behavior. No raw footage, locations, original filenames, timestamps, support logs, or settings payloads are published.

Scanner labels both groups Driving/continuous; this is classifier context, not proof that every sample is driving. Front samples cannot be assigned individually to driving or parking without retained filename links. Bitrate bands do not establish modes.

The second stored folder token is anonymized; the inside-to-telephoto mapping is owner testimony, not a decoded folder token. Historical inside-to-telephoto attribution is separately owner-confirmed; cross-scan physical clip identity is not established.

Only nested retained numeric pairs are measured evidence here; 902 inventoried MP4 entries are not 902 retained probes or proof of 902 distinct valid recordings. Historical and new inventories must not be summed as distinct clips.
Codec arrays are empty. No codec attribution is borrowed from historical ffprobe probes. No container bitrate or separate container duration is supplied in these samples.
Playback frame rates do not establish capture cadence, real elapsed parking coverage, within-file transitions, power draw, or firmware. No footage was read or decoded for this update.

Owner confirms time-lapse parking and S_ front parking prefix on the new 2CH setup. This setting is not transferred to the historical cohorts. Numeric samples have no retained per-sample filename links, so no new individual sample is labeled driving or parking. No new generic filename/channel override is introduced.

Separate collision-test cohort: 40 measured videos (20 front, 20 telephoto), all HEVC; 40 paired native alternate observations and 15 original submitted occurrences retained. Ordinary names do not resolve individual driving/parking mode. Four approximately five-minute two-view bursts do not prove impacts. No quality/firmware attribution or cross-scan clip deduplication is inferred.

Separate 3CH cohort adds 72 canonical HEVC clips: 28 front, 13 owner-confirmed telephoto (inside), 31 rear. Front S_ and rear Q_ are owner-confirmed time-lapse on this card; ordinary clips are driving-inferred. No telephoto time-lapse observed is not a universal disablement claim. Main UI-log firmware 8.0.0.23 and DR4004 protocol fields are cohort provenance, not per-clip metadata or physical component equivalence. Prior power cohorts are separate and unchanged.

technical_facts.label: Owner power measurements: 12.6 V, no cloud, DC009 hardwire cable
technical_facts.value: Driving, explicitly 2CH front/telephoto: 435 mA (5.481 W derived). Timelapse parking, ongoing recording: 282 mA (3.5532 W derived). Collision detection parking, idle monitoring: 52 mA (0.6552 W derived). Collision detection parking, event recording: 424 mA (5.3424 W derived). All four use the same owner configuration; active parking views are not separately established. Source reports current only; watts = 12.6 V × mA / 1000. Firmware, HDR, quality, capture FPS/SPF, day/night, exact meter hardware, wake and startup timings are unknown.

technical_facts.label: Measured collision idle versus earlier relayed claim
technical_facts.value: The new measured 52 mA at 12.6 V gives 0.6552 W, not the earlier owner-relayed 135 mW (0.135 W) claim. Equivalent test conditions for that claim are not established; it is not published as a measured row. Historical client-only custom claim links remain separate and unchanged.

technical_facts.label: Official advertised recording capability, not measured card attribution
technical_facts.value: Front wide-angle 3840x2160 at 30/25 FPS; front telephoto 2560x1440 at 25 FPS; rear 3840x2160 at 25 FPS. Advertised capabilities alone do not establish observed roles or connected setup; inside-to-telephoto mapping is separately owner-confirmed. Rear video evidence is now separately established by the 72-clip 3CH cohort; it does not retroactively attribute older cohorts.

technical_facts.label: Official advertised optics and sensors
technical_facts.value: DDPAI advertises a DualFocal 4K wide-angle and 2K telephoto system, F1.0/F2.0 front variable aperture, and Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678 front wide-angle and rear sensors. Not independently measured here.

technical_facts.label: Measured codec distribution
technical_facts.value: 401 videos: 391 HEVC and 10 H.264. 440 JPEGs are not video channels; 23 AppleDouble MP4-suffixed sidecars are excluded.

technical_facts.label: Firmware and configured settings
technical_facts.value: Firmware, quality, HDR, and capture cadence remain unknown. Time-lapse parking and complete front/telephoto setup are owner-confirmed only for the separate new scan. Historical inside-to-telephoto attribution is separately owner-confirmed; historical settings, front wide-angle attribution, and complete connected setup remain unconfirmed.

technical_facts.label: Separate owner scan coverage
technical_facts.value: 902 inventoried MP4 entries: front 621 and scanner interior 281 (owner-confirmed telephoto). Retained numeric samples: front 9 and telephoto 10; all 19 are numerically unique, with no exact six-field tuple overlap with the 19 historical scanner occurrences. Counts do not prove distinct clips across scans.

technical_facts.label: Separate owner 4CH power cohort: front/telephoto/rear/cabin
technical_facts.value: Historical — driving and timelapse superseded by explicit owner retest; original readings retained: Earlier 4CH test, before the latest owner-reported firmware update: Driving recording: 964 mA (12.1464 W derived). Timelapse parking: 632 mA (7.9632 W derived). Installed 4CH; active parking views not separately established. 12.6 V, cloud off, same DC009 hardwire cable. Rear firmware only: 9.0.0.17; main unit, front, cabin and telephoto firmware unknown. Rear 4K / cabin 3K are owner-declared, not measured card metadata. Collision detection idle and recording were pending in that earlier test; see the separate post-update readings below. Card scans pending; no new 4CH bitrate/FPS or timing measurements. Earlier 2CH power and video cohorts are unchanged.

technical_facts.label: Latest owner 4CH collision parking power (post-update)
technical_facts.value: Idle monitoring: 44 mA (0.5544 W derived). Event recording: 935 mA (11.781 W derived). 12.6 V, same DC009 hardwire cable; installed front + telephoto + 4K rear + 3K MINI3X cabin. Main firmware: 8.0.0.23, linked by same-unit UI-log observation and owner confirmation of no intervening updates; not read from these clips or power measurements. Component firmware remains unknown. Cloud off was prior setup context, not restated or independently verified after the update. Active parking views and startup/wake timings remain unknown. This separate cohort does not revise earlier power or video measurements or establish a firmware power reduction.

technical_facts.label: Current owner driving and timelapse power (explicit retest)
technical_facts.value: Driving: 1185 mA (14.931 W derived). Timelapse: 589 mA (7.4214 W derived). Explicit owner retest corrects current driving and timelapse only, superseding earlier 964 mA / 12.1464 W driving and 632 mA / 7.9632 W timelapse; original dossiers remain immutable history. Collision idle 44 mA / 0.5544 W and event recording 935 mA / 11.781 W remain current and unchanged. Installed front/telephoto/rear/MINI3X cabin (4 cameras). Owner tentatively reports front/rear indicated on the timelapse display and telephoto/cabin not seen saving; no clip verification establishes active recording views. Cabin LEDs being on does not prove saved footage. Whole-system supply-DC measurement, not isolated camera consumption. Main firmware 8.0.0.23 observed in fresh physical-card tracklog; MINI3X 9.0.1.10 observed in paired current-card product logs, not intrinsic clip metadata. Rear 9.0.0.17 belongs only to older cohort; current rear version unknown. 12.6 V and DC009 carried from standing current owner-test context, not restated in these messages. Cloud off belongs to earlier context; current connectivity unknown. Watts derived from current with Decimal. No capture FPS/SPF, wake/start timing or definitive recorded roles inferred.
